 THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.439 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.115/2023 REGISTERED BY BYADARAHALLI POLICE STATION, BENGALURU FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 376 AND 506 OF IPC AND SECTION 4 AND 6 OF POCSO ACT, PENDING ON THE FILE OF ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, FTSC-III, BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT, BENGALURU IN SPL.C.NO.585/2023.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner after arguing the matter for sometime submits that since the examination-in-chief of the victim girl has been deferred for want of the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., by the jurisdictional Magistrate, at this stage, the petition may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to approach the Court afresh after examination of the victim girl is completed before the trial Court.
The submission is placed on record.
The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
